data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Heartland Advisors' most recent 13F, for the period June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCYO and INBK.

On October 13, 2026, an Arapahoe County Board of County Commissioners agenda item mentioned Sky Ranch (approval) (https://arapahoe.legistar.com/MeetingDetail.aspx?LEGID=3038&GID=826&G=9CD90149-B010-432C-9FC8-7BF802574B0E).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot. Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
